 Job description - Role: Sr. Naval Architect Freelance - Work location: Amsterdam area, the Netherlands - Start: 24 August - Duration: Six months - Contract: Freelance assignment - Language: English - Focus: Weight calculation, weight estimation and weight monitoring for large superyachts 
As a Sr. Naval Architect, you will manage the Naval Architecture scope for one or more large superyacht projects. The main emphasis is on weight calculation, estimation and monitoring, supported by your knowledge of stability and regulatory compliance. You will work in an international, English-speaking project team. Relocation support is available when needed. 
Where You'll Work 
You will join a multidisciplinary engineering team working on large, fully custom-built superyachts. Reporting to the Lead Engineer, you will independently manage your assigned scope while coordinating with Project Management, Production, Engineering and external specialists. 
Detailed calculations and analyses may be prepared by external engineering partners. Your responsibility is to review and challenge these deliverables, maintain technical consistency and ensure that the weight development of each project remains controlled throughout engineering and construction. 
What You'll Do - Take technical ownership of the Naval Architecture scope for your assigned superyacht project or projects. - Prepare, review and maintain weight calculations, estimates, margins and weight-monitoring reports. - Track weight development throughout engineering and construction, identifying deviations and their potential consequences. - Review and challenge technical deliverables covering stability, hydrostatics, vessel performance and regulatory compliance. - Assess the effect of design changes on vessel weight, centre of gravity,...
